concepts.title: Updating Single Records & Atomic Numeric Operations
concepts.shortDescription: Prevent lost updates and race conditions using atomic database increments.

theory.summary: In concurrent environments (e.g. 50 users buying an item simultaneously), reading stock, calculating stock - 1 in JavaScript, and writing it back causes "lost updates". Prisma atomic operators (increment, decrement, multiply, divide) execute directly in SQL (SET stock = stock - 1), guaranteeing thread safety.

targetHero.explanation: Atomic increment prevents race conditions by running entirely in the database engine.

explanation: Race condition risk: Two requests read views: 10 at the same time. Both write views: 11. One view is lost!
Atomic solution: views: { increment: 1 } translates to UPDATE posts SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = 42.
theory.keyTakeaway: Always use { increment } / { decrement } for counters and inventory balances.

mcqs.question: Why should you use "{ stock: { decrement: 1 } }" instead of "data: { stock: currentStock - 1 }"?
options: To prevent race conditions where concurrent requests overwrite each other
Because Prisma does not allow numbers in data
Because decrement runs faster than JavaScript arithmetic
mcqs.explanation: Atomic operations are evaluated by the SQL engine in a single atomic step, eliminating race conditions.

concepts.title: Idempotent Workflows with upsert()
concepts.shortDescription: Update if exists, insert if missing in one atomic query.

theory.summary: upsert checks for the existence of a row by a unique constraint. If the row exists, it applies update: { ... }; if not, it executes create: { ... }.

targetHero.explanation: Ensures user preference exists and updates theme setting.

explanation: where: Must be a unique field or composite unique key.
update: Partial or full fields to update.
create: Full payload to create if nonexistent.
theory.keyTakeaway: Use upsert for user preferences, analytics counters, and webhook idempotency.

mcqs.question: Which clause in "prisma.model.upsert" dictates how existing rows are located?
mcqs.explanation: upsert requires an indexed unique field in where to determine if update or create should be executed.

hints.text: Use update: { views: { increment: 1 } } and create: { path: pagePath, views: 1 }.
